statement: ChainedCubicInverse15.norm_cubic, inverse_by_square and cubic_inverse_pair compile with the pinned Lean4.35.0 and default proof limits. For an arbitrary standard Lean.Grind.Field K and nonzero a, the original norm pair at (a,0) equals (a inverse,0). All three print only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. This is conditional standard-field algebra, without a Rust cubic Field instance or general Picard bridge; producer remains unsigned.
